testcase.name: undo of a pending entry delete shows it again and deletes nothing
committing a pending entry delete deletes exactly that entry, once
a second entry delete commits the first when it replaces it
a requested draft delete hides it from the visible drafts and leaves the committed entries
a requested entry delete hides it from the visible entries and deletes nothing
a failed entry delete puts it back and says so
a delete asked for an entry that is not loaded pends nothing
an entry delete still pending when the ViewModel is cleared is committed
